body.statement: Remark 2.3 of Yu, Shi, and Tchetgen Tchetgen's cited preprint displays a matrix \(M\in\mathbb R^{12\times15}\) and states that it is full rank.

source.verbatim_statement: the matrix \(M \in \mathbb R^{12 \times 15}\) is full rank

attestation.note: Narrowed the cited lemma to the exact sentence transcribed from Remark 2.3 of the arXiv v2 TeX source at main.tex lines 369–372. Nearby displayed lists and column composition are not treated as covered by this verbatim field.
